title: actor.list result, contract version 1
description: The result of actor.list (PRD 5.16, 12.2): a page of staff actors, each with its state, version and profile. A profile is null where the reader may not read it, and its values are personal data, left out for a reader whose classification access does not allow personal. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Identity\Domain\Dto\ActorList, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

next.description: The id to read the next page after, or null when this page is the last.

profile.description: The actor's profile, or null when the reader may not read it.
An actor's profile (PRD 5.16, 12.2). Both values are personal data, classified personal: a reader whose classification access does not allow personal gets the profile without them.

display_name.description: The name the actor's profile shows, 1 to 200 characters without control characters, that starts and ends with a character that is not white space. Personal data, left out below personal access.

email.description: The contact email address of the actor's profile, at most 254 characters. Personal data, left out below personal access.
